responsibility: Implements statement folding by value range for the ranger subsystem. It defines fur_source abstractions that obtain operand ranges from statements, edges, explicit lists, or GORI-aware dependence contexts, and it uses them in fold_using_range to evaluate GIMPLE statements, PHIs, calls, address expressions, and conditional expressions to resulting ranges while also registering discovered operand relations for downstream reasoning.
same_name_distinction: Implements the folding engine and operand-source subclasses declared for gimple-range-fold, including fur_source variants, fold_using_range behavior, relation registration, and edge/path-aware folding logic. Unlike gcc/gimple-range-fold.h, it is the execution of range folding rather than the public entry points and class declarations.
